exact_output.claim_level: computed modular-data evidence / restricted supported evaluator
exact_output.not_scope: arbitrary colored link evaluator, arbitrary linking-matrix evaluator, trefoil, Borromean rings, Hopf-star encircling diagrams, F/R-symbol traces, dotted/special links, closed 4-manifold normalization, or exotic-pair computation
exact_output.scope: SU(2)_6 modular data plus split-union of unknots/Hopf-pairs evaluator

supported_link_class.component_rule: each component must occur in exactly one supported block
explicitly_rejected: trefoil or other nontrivial knot component
Hopf-star / one component encircling multiple nontrivial components
any diagram needing F-symbol or R-symbol fusion-space traces
supported_link_class.omega_rule: Omega_a = sum_j d_j (-1)^(a*j) X_j, with a in Z/2
supported_link_class.reason_for_rejecting_hopf_star: In non-pointed categories, a central loop around several components depends on fusion channels of the enclosed labels.  Pairwise linking data alone is not a safe evaluator.

notes: This artifact covers SU(2)_6 modular data and a restricted supported link class only.
It deliberately rejects arbitrary linking matrices and diagrams requiring F/R-symbol traces.
